wire.headline: Utility firm reports profit decline as it announces job cuts and plant closures
sentences: The company reported a 7% year-on-year increase in revenue to 4.26bn GBP for the quarter ending 30 September.
Pre-tax profit fell by 12% to 310m GBP.
The firm plans to cut 850 jobs, which represents about 6% of its workforce.
Two gas plants, one located in Wales and one in Kent, are scheduled to close by March 2027.
CEO Marian Holt stated that cost pressure was sharper than expected.
Ofgem has opened an investigation into the company's billing system.
The dividend was held at 12.4p a share.

PD.headline: Kestrel Securities faces major job cuts and union threat

sentences.text: For the quarter ending 30 September, the company reported a year-on-year revenue increase of 7%, reaching 4.26bn GBP.
The company is set to make 850 job cuts, which represents about 6% of its workforce.
CEO Marian Holt stated that the cost pressure is sharper than expected.
A Kestrel Securities analyst noted that the job cuts will save 90m GBP a year.
Unite has announced it will ballot members on industrial action.
The MP for Deeside is asking for an urgent meeting with the company.
The company confirmed that customer bills will remain unchanged until April 2027.

ND.headline: Energy firm announces job cuts and profit drop

sentences.text: The company reported a pre-tax profit decline of 12% to 310m GBP.
It plans to cut 850 jobs, which represents about 6% of its workforce.
A Kestrel Securities analyst stated that these job cuts will save 90m GBP a year.
The union Unite has announced it will ballot members on industrial action.
The Kent plant employs 410 staff, leaving the local supply chain exposed.
The MP for Deeside is asking for an urgent meeting with the company.
Since 2024, 1,200 staff have left under a voluntary scheme.
Ofgem is expected to report preliminary findings by the end of 2026.
Shares closed at 268p, marking a drop of 11p.
A customer group recorded 3,400 billing complaints in a six-month period.
Talks with unions are scheduled to start on 4 November.
In 2023, Ofgem fined the company 1.8m GBP over billing issues.
The company stated there will be no compulsory redundancies before January 2027.
Kestrel Securities reduced its price target to 240p from 290p.
This news was reported by the Western Mail.
